intuition: A queue exposes its oldest item, so rotating all older items behind a newly pushed value makes that value the front.

brute_force.approach: Keep a list and remove its final element for each pop.
brute_force.time: push O(1), pop O(1), top O(1), empty O(1)

optimal.approach: Use one queue and rotate the existing elements after each push so the newest value is at the front.
optimal.time: push O(n), pop O(1), top O(1), empty O(1)

edge_cases: The latest pushed value is always the next value removed.
A one-element stack needs no rotation.
